system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Several Zeek records show similarly sized connections from WS-LMARTINS-01 to the proxy during the review window, including at 13:45:47, 13:50:50, 13:54:56, 13:55:53, 14:00:49, and 14:06:31 UTC. These records identify the proxy connection, but not the external destination or initiating process.

At 14:11:07 UTC, the proxy recorded a connection to updates.pixelforge-suite.co, while Sysmon recorded pfupdater.exe running from the user's AppData\Roaming directory and connecting to the proxy at the same time. The supplied inventory instead lists updates.pixelforge-suite.com and a Program Files updater path; this discrepancy is suspicious but does not by itself establish malicious activity.

A connection to clients6.google.com was recorded with the user agent GoogleDriveFS; the supplied inventory approves Microsoft 365 / OneDrive and says no other cloud-storage services are approved. This establishes observed Google Drive-related traffic, not that files were uploaded or that the activity was malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied coverage metadata reports that WS-LMARTINS-01 winsec and Sysmon logs, and proxy logs, were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC due to an outage.
Zeek connection records are available, but the cited records show connections to the internal proxy and do not identify the external destination or originating process.
claims_not_established: Whether the repeated proxy connections during the outage went to PixelForge, another approved service, or an unapproved destination.
Whether the recurring connections were initiated by the pfupdater.exe process observed at 14:11 UTC.
Whether the observed .co destination or AppData\Roaming updater path was authorized, and whether the binary was signed or otherwise legitimate.
Whether any data was uploaded, what it contained, or whether the activity was performed with malicious intent.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover proxy logs, if available, for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including CONNECT destinations, users, user agents, and byte counts.
Collect endpoint process and network telemetry for WS-LMARTINS-01 covering the outage window; correlate process IDs and executable hashes with the recurring connections.
Verify the pfupdater.exe file's signature, hash, provenance, and installation history, and confirm whether updates.pixelforge-suite.co is an authorized destination.
Review endpoint or proxy data for evidence of file access or transfer associated with the GoogleDriveFS traffic.
